name: NU Packaging
old_description: Jim founded NU Packaging in 2001 after spending two decades in the industry, driven by a desire to bring a greater sense of fun and creativity to packaging. Over the past 25 years he poured his passion, deep knowledge, and genuine warmth into building a company that values innovation, reliability, and a welcoming, friendly spirit, making NU Packaging a trusted partner for countless clients. Though we were deeply saddened by Jim’s passing in June 2025, his vision and enthusiasm continue to inspire and guide our team every day as we honor his legacy by carrying forward the culture, values, and commitment he created.
about:
NU Packaging operates from Salt Lake City, Utah. The company was founded in 2001 by Jim, who had spent two decades in the packaging industry and wanted to bring a more creative, enjoyable approach to the business. It remains family-owned and operated. Jim passed away in June 2025, and the team continues to run the business according to his original vision.

NU Packaging functions as both a wholesale packaging distributor and a box manufacturer. Following the acquisition of a local box-making facility, the company produces custom-sized corrugated boxes on demand at its Salt Lake City plant. It also provides vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and stocking agreements backed by live inventory reporting updated every 12 hours. Delivery runs daily with next-day service to the Salt Lake and Utah Valleys, and twice weekly to Davis and Weber Counties with on-demand flexibility. The staff collectively holds over 120 years of packaging experience.

The company serves businesses across the Wasatch Front, from startups to large regional retailers. Its customer base includes technology firms in the Silicon Slopes corridor, manufacturers in Ogden and Davis County, and other organizations needing wholesale packaging supplies, custom corrugated designs, or automated packaging solutions.

Jim started the company to inject a sense of fun and creativity into packaging, emphasizing innovation, reliability, and a welcoming culture. NU Packaging differentiates itself through a local, human-staffed customer service team, on-demand manufacturing that cuts material waste and shipping costs, and a "Full Package" model that designs, manufactures, stocks, and delivers packaging under one roof.
